sources.title: Historical chancellor biography and dated career table
sources.findings: Read official historical chancellor CV and dated career table: June14 1958 Osnabrück; law studies 1978–1984, civilian service 1984–1985, lawyer from1985; labour minister2007–2009, Hamburg First Mayor2011–2018, finance ministerMarch2018–December2021, chancellorDecember2021–May6 2025. Acting SPD chairFebruary–April2018 distinct from permanent government offices. Historical photo caption calling him caretaker chancellor is not treated as current2026 office. No doctoral degree inferred. Exact2001 interior-senator month discrepancy with LeMO not repeated.

sources.title: Olaf Scholz biography, updated 29 June 2026
sources.findings: Read relevant LeMO biography sections, updatedJune29 2026: early legal/career history, Hamburg majority2011, finance minister/vice-chancellor2018, coalition2021 and departure2025. Sectoral postal wage floor2007 differs from nationwide minimum wage2015 and2022 increase. Avoided imprecise source labels CDU28.5% rather than combinedUnion, October1998 election wording and differing2001 interior-service endpoint. Cum-Ex discussion records uncertainty, not personal conviction; profile does not turn suspicion into guilt or declare an exoneration. No complete case-file or parliamentary-inquiry audit.

sources.title: 8 December 2021 chancellor election: 395 votes for Scholz
sources.findings: Read Bundestag December8 2021 election report:395 for,303 against,6 abstentions,3 invalid among707 ballots;704 valid is compatible, not a conflicting total. Election by Bundestag followed by presidential appointment, not direct election of head of state. SPD/Greens/FDP coalition. Old report introduction concerning Merkel caretaker service in2021 not confused with Scholz2025.

sources.title: Friedrich Merz at the chancellery handover, 6 May 2025
sources.findings: Read official May6 2025 handover speech by Friedrich Merz, confirming actual chancellery transition. Merz praise of predecessor is political assessment, not an independent policy-effect evaluation. Handover endpoint used alongside March25 caretaker-start record, not an assertion no constitutional change occurred inMarch.

sources.title: Scholz government enters caretaker service, 25 March 2025
sources.findings: Read Tagesschau March25 2025 report: new Bundestag constituted, Steinmeier delivered dismissal documents, requested continued government business until replacement underArticle69. Caretaker service not re-election or same-day departure from all duties. Article also explains November2024 coalition breakdown and Wissing remaining as independent; not every FDP minister left immediately. Forecasts about an Easter cabinet were not actual appointment dates.

sources.title: 16 December 2024 confidence vote and result
sources.findings: Read Bundestag December16 2024 confidence report:207 yes,394 no,116 abstentions,16 absent;717 votes cast,367 required. Not constructive vote of no confidence underArticle67 or impeachment. Losing confidence does not itself immediately remove the chancellor. Opposing politicians’ quoted attacks not adopted as independently established facts.

sources.title: Report on constitutional judgment 2 BvF 1/22, 15 November 2023
sources.findings: Read Bundestag account of Federal Constitutional Court judgment2BvF1/22 deliveredNovember15 2023: SecondSupplementaryBudgetAct2021 void; €60b unused pandemic borrowing authority transferred retrospectively to EnergyClimateFund/laterClimateTransformationFund for later fiscal years. Budget year2021 distinct from parliamentary passageJanuary27 2022, statute dateFebruary18 and promulgationFebruary25. Not a criminal judgment against Scholz and not voiding every2023 budget measure. Direct English judgment and English court press-release URLs returned403; do not claim direct full-judgment inspection.

sources.title: Government statement in the Bundestag, 27 February 2022
sources.findings: Read federal-government February27 2022 statement in Bundestag: Russia invasionFebruary24 context; proposed one-off€100b Bundeswehr special fund in2022. Announcement and future procurement distinct from all spending or delivery completed that day. Greater-than2%-GDP aspiration not represented as achieved2022 expenditure. Quotations and political expectations not guarantees.

sources.publisher: Federal Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs
sources.title: Parliament passes minimum-wage increase effective 1 October 2022
sources.findings: Read BMAS June3 2022 release: Bundestag approved government bill that day, statutory minimum-wage increase to€12/hour effectiveOctober1 2022. Existing national system began2015 perLeMO;12 is dated historical figure, not current2026 statutory rate. Ministry predictions about beneficiaries and poverty effects not presented as independently measured outcomes.

sources.title: Hamburg speech supporting Ukraine, report published 17 November 2026
sources.findings: Read NDR/Tagesschau report publishedTuesdayNovember17 2026 at06:06, describing completed speech Mondayevening atHausRissen Hamburg; actual event thereforeNovember16. Former chancellor advocated continuedUkraine support and defended military aid. Report date differs from speech date; unverified casualty totals and donor-ranking rhetoric omitted. Event announcements and video-listing dates alone not used as attendance proof. No claim to have watched linked video.
